# OpenCode V1/V2 Mobile

> Android client for the OpenCode AI coding agent. One APK that speaks both the
> opencode 1.x API (V1) and the opencode 2.x API (V2), auto-detected per
> connection, with a manual override in Settings.

Repository: https://github.com/cfyz1297/opencode-v1-v2-mobile
Language: English, Russian (README.ru.md), Simplified Chinese (in-app)
License: MIT

## What it is

A native Android app (Expo / React Native, TypeScript) that drives a
self-hosted `opencode serve` from a phone: streamed transcript, tool approvals,
diffs, model and reasoning-effort switching, session history, offline read-only
copy, biometric unlock.

It is a fork of https://github.com/dzianisv/opencode-mobile (itself a mobile
client for https://github.com/sst/opencode), with two differences that matter:
support for both server API generations, and no telemetry at all (Sentry and
PostHog were removed).

## How it connects

The device talks directly to the user's own opencode server over HTTPS with
HTTP Basic auth. There is no backend, no account and no analytics. Nothing
(prompts, code, URLs, keys) is sent anywhere except to the server the user
configures.

The transport is chosen by probing the address once (src/lib/api-detect.ts):

- `GET /api/info` answers JSON (or 401/403) -> V2, opencode 2.x
- otherwise `GET /global/health` answers JSON (or 401/403) -> V1, opencode 1.18.x
- HTML on both -> not an opencode server; the connection is refused

The decision is based on the response body and content type, never on the
status code: an unknown route on either server generation falls through to the
web UI and answers `200 text/html`.

## Install

https://github.com/cfyz1297/opencode-v1-v2-mobile/releases/latest/download/opencode-mobile-v2.apk

Android 7+ (minSdk 24). Signed with a permanent key, installs over previous
versions. Not published to Google Play or F-Droid.

## Source map

- `app/` — Expo Router screens (session, connections, models, settings)
- `src/lib/` — SDK and transports: `sdk.ts` (V2), `sdk-v1.ts` (V1),
  `api-detect.ts`, `v2-compat.ts` (event adapter), plus pure helpers
- `src/stores/` — zustand stores (connections, sessions, events, settings)
- `src/components/` — UI, including `chat/ToolCallCard`, `chat/ContextRing`
- `HANDOFF.md` — engineering state, what shipped and what is left
- `docs/` — upstream review and security review

Verification: `npm test` (635 tests, node built-in runner), `npm run typecheck`,
`npm run check:versions`, `npm run test:coverage` (about 98% of lines).
